title: A decision that changed: the latest one counts

+messages.text: Pentru ziua mamei luăm tortul de la Patiseria Ana, îl comand eu.
Schimbare: Patiseria Ana nu mai face torturi. Am comandat de la Cofetăria Dalia, cu fructe de pădure.
Bine. Îți trimit diseară banii pentru jumătate din tort.

turns.user: De unde luăm tortul pentru ziua mamei?

judge.rubric: Gives the latest decision as the current one; if it mentions the earlier plan, it says that plan was dropped.
judge.truth: Cofetăria Dalia, with forest fruit; Mihai ordered it 6 days ago. The earlier plan, Patiseria Ana (20 days ago), was dropped because they no longer make cakes. Andrei still owes Mihai half the price.
